name: Kikyou
source:
Three years after moving to Tokyo, Nozomu returns to his hometown for the first time.
By chance, he ends up visiting the home of Haruka, his childhood friend—and the boy he once had feelings for.
As Nozomu spends time with Haruka in the place where they grew up, just like in the old days, the feelings he kept buried deep inside gradually begin to surface…
